_about: How the face's soft parts sway, for tools/face_tissue.py with hmcore/skin_waves.py (initiative animation-face, epic face-soft-tissue), by eye, to be tuned against recordings. gain: how much of the inertia reaches the skin, 0 to 1; hz: its natural frequency; damping: its damping ratio; speed: how fast a wave crosses it, m/s; limit_m: the most any point leaves its place. Lips are kept light, so the sway doesn't open what lip_contact.py seals. The base is the rest of the face and body, which doesn't sway.
